chains.title: No TF-mediated allelic effect; association is explained by a linked causal variant or no causal effect
predictions: No allele-specific TF binding at rs7001688 in hepatocyte-relevant assays.
No allele-specific enhancer/reporter activity difference for rs7001688 itself.
Any CYP7A1 or LDL cholesterol association is driven by a linked variant, not by rs7001688.
rs7001688 behaves as a passenger or marker variant.
falsified_if: A reproducible allele-specific TF binding and enhancer effect is demonstrated for rs7001688.
The allelic reporter effect is abolished by knocking down the named TF.

chains.title: HNF4A binding gain at a liver enhancer increases CYP7A1 and lowers LDL cholesterol

links.claim: The alt T allele is predicted to strengthen a hepatocyte HNF4A binding site at rs7001688, so HNF4A binds the alt allele more strongly than the ref G allele.
The allele-specific HNF4A site lies in a liver enhancer that can regulate CYP7A1.
Increased HNF4A binding at this element increases CYP7A1 transcription.
This mechanism occurs in hepatocytes, with HepG2/DepMap ACH-000625 as a relevant expression context.
Higher CYP7A1 activity increases bile-acid synthesis from cholesterol and lowers LDL cholesterol.

predictions: Alt T increases allele-specific HNF4A occupancy in HepG2 hepatocytes.
Alt T increases reporter activity in an allele-specific CYP7A1 enhancer reporter.
Alt T is associated with higher CYP7A1 expression in liver/hepatocyte context.
Alt T is associated with lower LDL cholesterol.
falsified_if: No allele-specific HNF4A binding is detectable at rs7001688.
The alt allele does not increase enhancer/reporter activity, or the effect is not HNF4A-dependent.
CYP7A1 expression is not higher with the alt allele in hepatocyte-relevant assays.

chains.title: NR5A2/LRH-1 binding loss at a liver enhancer reduces CYP7A1 and raises LDL cholesterol

links.claim: The ref G allele is predicted to preserve a stronger NR5A2/LRH-1 binding site than the alt T allele at rs7001688.
The NR5A2 site lies in a liver enhancer that can regulate CYP7A1.
Stronger NR5A2 binding at this element increases CYP7A1 transcription.
This occurs in hepatocytes, consistent with the HepG2 expression context.
Higher CYP7A1 activity lowers LDL cholesterol.

predictions: Ref G increases allele-specific NR5A2 occupancy in HepG2 hepatocytes.
Ref G increases reporter activity in an allele-specific CYP7A1 enhancer reporter.
Ref G is associated with higher CYP7A1 expression.
Ref G is associated with lower LDL cholesterol.
falsified_if: No allele-specific NR5A2 binding is detectable at rs7001688.
Ref G does not increase enhancer/reporter activity in hepatocyte models.
NR5A2 knockdown does not reduce the allele-specific reporter effect.

chains.title: FXR/NR1H4 binding gain represses CYP7A1 and raises LDL cholesterol

links.claim: The alt T allele is predicted to create or strengthen an NR1H4/FXR binding site at rs7001688, so FXR binds alt more strongly than ref.
The allele-specific FXR site lies in a liver regulatory element capable of repressing CYP7A1.
Increased FXR binding represses CYP7A1 transcription, directly or through SHP-mediated repression.
This occurs in hepatocytes, consistent with HepG2 as a liver-derived context.
Lower CYP7A1 activity reduces bile-acid synthesis and raises LDL cholesterol.

predictions: Alt T increases allele-specific FXR occupancy in HepG2 hepatocytes.
Alt T decreases CYP7A1 enhancer/reporter activity, consistent with FXR-mediated repression.
Alt T is associated with lower CYP7A1 expression.
Alt T is associated with higher LDL cholesterol.
falsified_if: No allele-specific FXR binding is detectable at rs7001688.
Alt T does not reduce CYP7A1 reporter activity in hepatocyte models.
FXR knockdown or ligand treatment does not alter the allele-specific effect.

ref reporter > alt reporter; effect reduced by NR5A2 knockdown
alt reporter < ref reporter; effect altered by FXR knockdown/ligand

matrix.test: CYP7A1 expression by allele in hepatocyte-relevant context

next_experiment: The single cheapest experiment to separate the top two chains C1_HNF4A and C0_null is an allele-specific CYP7A1 enhancer luciferase reporter assay in HepG2 cells comparing ref G versus alt T, with and without HNF4A knockdown. C1_HNF4A predicts alt > ref reporter activity and loss of the allelic difference upon HNF4A knockdown; C0_null predicts no reproducible rs7001688 allele-specific reporter effect.
